metadata.title: Topotecan Oral Monotherapy
metadata.indication: Relapsed SCLC when retreatment with first-line therapy is not appropriate.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source-reconciled organ-function encoding · clinical/pharmacy review pending

organ_function_reconciliation.note: Structured renal/hepatic component rules were reconciled to the current official NCCP regimen source. Independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation remains pending.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.source_retrieval_method: Current official PDF downloaded with browser User-Agent; complete text and original dose tables visually inspected
metadata.source_review_status: Current NCCP catalogue-linked PDF checked 2026-11-02; printed next review date has passed.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Confirm source-specific route, selected schedule, stage, recovery and consultant decision. Never multiply overlapping dose percentages or convert oral and IV doses automatically.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00587 Version 2. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Source reconciled in SACTCheck v0.84.29; independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation pending.

indications.description: Relapsed SCLC when retreatment with first-line therapy is not appropriate.

treatment.schedule_summary: Topotecan capsules once daily on Days 1–5, every 21 days, for up to 6 cycles or earlier progression/unacceptable toxicity.

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

febrile_or_active_infection.label: Fever, febrile neutropenia or active infection requiring treatment

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst relevant non-haematological toxicity

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Grade 2 under the named CTCAE term: generally moderate; local/non-invasive intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Grade 3 under the named CTCAE term: severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event, grade it with its own CTCAE criteria and assess functional impact before selecting a grade.
other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.grading_source_label: NCCP 00587 adverse-event table; grading edition unspecified
other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.source_grading_note: Source action table does not specify grading edition. Confirm named event and grade using local verified grading policy.

renal_input.reason: Route-specific NCCP renal bands; exact decimal gaps remain unresolved.

febrile_neutropenia.label: Confirmed febrile neutropenia in prior cycle

neutropenia_with_infection.label: Neutropenia with infection in prior cycle

severe_neutropenia_7days.label: ANC <0.5 for at least 7 days in prior cycle

ild_suspected.label: Possible interstitial lung disease needing assessment

absorption_problem.label: Gastrointestinal condition or medicine affecting absorption

oral_dose_confirmed.label: Capsule dose and Days1–5 schedule confirmed

diarrhoea_grade.label: Diarrhoea grade
diarrhoea_grade.grading_source_label: NCCP 00587 adverse-event table; grading edition unspecified
diarrhoea_grade.source_grading_note: Source action table does not specify grading edition. Confirm named event and grade using local verified grading policy.
diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: Confirm named event and grade; do not infer grade from a single nonspecific symptom.

current_topotecan_dose_mg_m2.label: Documented current oral topotecan daily dose
current_topotecan_dose_mg_m2.assessment_guidance: Enter the documented protocol dose per day, not capsule count or the patient-specific milligram dose. Needed before applying the renal target quoted from a full 2.3 mg/m² starting dose.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded restriction was triggered in the entered domain(s). This is not an overall treatment clearance.

eligibility: Indication as listed in the current official NCCP regimen
Performance status, histology, stage and biomarker eligibility appropriate to the selected indication
Organ function appropriate for the selected regimen
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
Regimen-specific exclusions encoded in the interactive assessment
monitoring: FBC, renal and liver profile as specified by the current NCCP regimen
Treatment-specific pulmonary, cardiac, endocrine, neurological and biomarker monitoring as applicable
dose_modifications: Only the currently structured inputs and decision rules are operational in SACTCheck. Renal and hepatic source requirements may still require manual review of the current official NCCP PDF.

treatment_phases.label: Five-day topotecan course
treatment_phases.duration_text: Up to 6 cycles; stop earlier for progression or unacceptable toxicity.
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: Topotecan capsules once daily on Days 1–5, every 21 days, for up to 6 cycles or earlier progression/unacceptable toxicity.

administration.note: Swallow whole; take with or without food. Refrigerate 2–8°C; do not freeze. No automatic replacement/double dose.
